title: Create mobile-responsive design pass across all dashboard and marketing pages
acceptance_criteria: All marketing pages fully responsive: hero, features, pricing sections adapt to mobile
Dashboard sidebar collapses to bottom nav or hamburger menu on screens < 768px
Analysis results page sections stack vertically on mobile instead of tabs
Upload dropzone is touch-friendly with larger tap targets on mobile
Tables switch to card layout on mobile (horizontal scroll as fallback)
Forms have appropriate input sizing and spacing for touch devices
Ad slots resize correctly on mobile viewport (320px-768px)
